newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Bank of Cyprus in 25 mln pound rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Cyprus in 25 mln pound rights issue.

text.p: The Bank of Cyprus (Holdings) will proceed with a rights issue of 12.5 million shares worth 25 million pounds ($49.75 million) next month, the bank said.
The shares will be issued at a ratio of 1 for every 8 shares held on May 21 at the price of two pounds per share, the bank said in a statement.

The amount is fully payable on the exercise date which is not later than June 27. The new shares will rank pari passu with existing shares and will be entitled to the dividends payable after the exercise date.
In accordance with the Cyprus Stock Exchange (CSE) regulations the shares will be quoted ex-rights as from May 9.
